commonDirection: Use the Kilnforged family plate only as authoritative family style and material reference: a foundry worker fused into the furnace system, bottom-heavy weighted armor much broader at the lower torso than the shoulders, three separated furnace chambers with open-air gaps and visible chain tendons, soot-clogged gill vents, a small faceless firebrick kiln-mouth head with hinged iron damper, asymmetrical embedded foundry tools, and heavy cracked refractory-stone feet. Palette: soot iron, restrained furnace orange, black heat scale, dull brick gray, muted oxide red. Materials: pitted forged iron, cracked firebrick, vitrified slag, greasy chain, heat-blued scale, powdery soot. Cold raking studio light opposed by restrained internal chamber heat. Original canonical form, not a copy of the plate subject. Polished stylized 3D dark-fantasy MMORPG production concept, mature material density, one complete subject in three-quarter view, every extremity and mechanic cue visible, centered with generous clearance. Flat near-black neutral opaque studio backdrop; no environment, floor, ground plane, cast floor shadow, extra unrelated figure, text, readable symbols, runes, real religious marks, logo, watermark, franchise resemblance, heroic power armor, steampunk boiler-person shorthand, clean knight, generic lava elemental, oversized shoulders, glossy plastic, cute proportions, bright saturation, gore, or exposed entrails.

canonical.anatomy: A foundry laborer riveted inside a cooling suit after the last shift refused to end. The violation closes into a usable limb when molten slag gathers along the lifted tool head.
canonical.locomotion: It crosses ground in one committed weight transfer, then must reassemble its balance; the permission cue is molten slag gathers along the lifted tool head.
canonical.sound: Ember iron produces a load-bearing groan, one blunt beat, and a long settling scrape; Slag Hammer commits on the first strike/fire sound after the gap.
canonical.purpose: Foundry workers and royal guards fused into the furnace systems they were ordered to seal. This form serves the niche expressed by a foundry laborer riveted inside a cooling suit after the last shift refused to end.
canonical.origin: A foundry laborer riveted inside a cooling suit after the last shift refused to end.
canonical.cue: Molten slag gathers along the lifted tool head.
canonical.counterplay: Move to the cool side of the suit and punish the embedded hammer.

cutoutDirection: After a master receives two independent non-generator passes, edit that exact master only to remove its studio background. Preserve canvas dimensions, pose, topology, design, materials, lighting, scale, placement, silhouette, exact-count cues, and RGB identity. Output genuine RGBA: background and four corners alpha 0, opaque subject interiors alpha 255, partial alpha only at true antialiased/fine-fiber edges; no painted transparency pattern, floor, shadow, matte, halo, text, logo, or watermark.
